description: This file defines the 'Skill' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a skill with properties such as id, name, description, and associated employee skills. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter/setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: Entity class representing a skill, mapped to the 'ohrm_skill' database table, with properties for id, name, description, and related employee skills.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the skill.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the skill.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the skill.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the skill.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the skill.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the skill.
